activities.title: Walk without headphones
activities.desc: A slow loop around the block with nothing in your ears.
activities.why: Gives your mind room to wander — the place good ideas show up.
steps: Leave your phone in your pocket
Notice three sounds you usually miss

activities.title: Call someone for ten minutes
activities.desc: Pick one person you have not spoken to in a while and just say hi.
activities.why: A short, real conversation does more than an hour of feeds.
steps: Open with “I was just thinking about you”
Ask one question about their week

activities.title: Cook something with one new ingredient
activities.desc: Make a familiar dish, but swap in one thing you have never used.
activities.why: Small novelty, a real result you can taste.
steps: Pick one new spice, herb or vegetable
Write down how it turned out

activities.title: Sketch what is in front of you
activities.desc: Pen, paper, one object. No erasing.
activities.why: Drawing forces you to actually look — the opposite of scrolling.
steps: Draw it for ten minutes without erasing

activities.title: Read one chapter on paper
activities.desc: A physical book, a comfortable chair, one chapter.
activities.why: Deep attention is a muscle; this is the gentle workout.
steps: Put your phone in another room

activities.title: Bodyweight session
activities.desc: Squats, push-ups, a plank. Three rounds.
activities.why: Burns restless energy fast and leaves you clearer.

activities.title: Visit a place you have never been
activities.desc: A café, park, or shop within 20 minutes that you keep passing.
activities.why: New places make time feel fuller — and more memorable.

activities.title: Write a letter to a friend
activities.desc: Handwritten or typed — one page about what you appreciate in them.
activities.why: Gratitude shared lands twice: once for them, once for you.
steps: Write three things you value about them
Send it, or give it in person

activities.title: Learn three words in a new language
activities.desc: Pick a language you are curious about and learn three useful words.
activities.why: Tiny, finishable learning with a real sense of progress.
steps: Learn hello, thank you, and one favourite word

activities.title: Five-minute room reset
activities.desc: Clear one surface completely. Only one.
activities.why: A visible win in five minutes — a calm reset for your head too.

activities.title: Play an instrument or hum a song
activities.desc: Any instrument, or just your voice. Learn eight bars of something.
activities.why: Making sound is more absorbing than consuming it.

activities.title: Sit outside and watch the sky
activities.desc: Ten minutes, no phone, just clouds or stars.
activities.why: Low effort, high calm — good when you feel drained.
steps: Count slow breaths until you lose track

activities.title: Invite someone for chai or coffee
activities.desc: Message one person and suggest a specific time this week.
activities.why: Plans with a time attached actually happen.

activities.title: Go for a run or brisk walk
activities.desc: Out the door, 15 minutes one way, then turn around.
activities.why: Restless energy has somewhere useful to go.

activities.title: Try a new recipe from a cookbook
activities.desc: Choose something slightly beyond your comfort zone.
activities.why: A satisfying, shareable project with a clear finish line.

activities.title: Photograph one colour
activities.desc: Walk and photograph everything that is one chosen colour.
activities.why: Uses your camera to see more, not scroll more.
steps: Pick your favourite and keep it

activities.title: Stretch for ten minutes
activities.desc: Neck, shoulders, back, hips. Slowly.
activities.why: Your body has been holding a phone posture. Undo it.

activities.title: Watch a talk and take notes
activities.desc: One deliberately chosen talk — then close the app.
activities.why: Intentional watching, with something to show for it.
steps: Choose one talk before opening the app
Close the app when it ends

activities.title: Volunteer an hour
activities.desc: A local shelter, a cleanup, or helping a neighbour.
activities.why: Meaning and connection in one hour.

activities.title: Board game or cards
activities.desc: With family, flatmates, or a friend.
activities.why: Shared play is one of the quickest ways to feel close.

activities.title: Plant or repot something
activities.desc: Herbs on a window sill, or repot a tired plant.
activities.why: Something alive you get to watch grow.
steps: Put it where you will see it daily

activities.title: Write 300 words of anything
activities.desc: A story, a memory, an argument. 300 words, then stop.
activities.why: Creating beats consuming — and it is finished in 20 minutes.
steps: Open a page in your Journal

activities.title: Visit a library or bookshop
activities.desc: Browse a section you never visit.
activities.why: Serendipity without an algorithm.

activities.title: Dance to three songs
activities.desc: Door closed, volume up.
activities.why: Ten minutes that change your whole mood.

activities.title: Make a zine about your week
activities.desc: Fold one sheet into an 8-page mini book and fill it with doodles and notes.
activities.why: A tiny finished object you made with your hands.
steps: Fold an A4 sheet into 8 panels
One page per day of your week
Give it to someone or keep it

activities.title: Paint with only three colours
activities.desc: Any paint, any paper — just three colours.
activities.why: Limits make creating easier, not harder.
steps: Paint something you can see from your seat

activities.title: Write a six-word story
activities.desc: A whole story in exactly six words. Write five versions.
activities.why: Quick, playful, and surprisingly absorbing.

activities.title: Rearrange a corner of your room
activities.desc: Move furniture, objects or art in one corner to make it feel new.
activities.why: Changing your space changes how it feels to be in it.

activities.title: Try calligraphy or hand lettering
activities.desc: Write one quote you love, slowly and beautifully.
activities.why: Slowness on purpose — the opposite of a feed.
steps: Write the full quote once neatly

activities.title: Find the oldest tree nearby
activities.desc: Walk your neighbourhood looking for the biggest, oldest tree.
activities.why: A small quest that gets you outside and noticing.
steps: Sit under the tree you choose for five minutes

activities.title: Sunrise or sunset walk
activities.desc: Time a walk to catch the sky changing colour.
activities.why: The best free show in the world, daily.

activities.title: Picnic in a park
activities.desc: Pack simple food and eat somewhere green.
activities.why: Ordinary food tastes better outside with company.

activities.title: Birdwatch for fifteen minutes
activities.desc: Count how many different birds you can see or hear.
activities.why: Trains patient attention — and it is oddly delightful.

activities.title: Walk a street you have never walked
activities.desc: Pick a nearby street you always skip and walk all of it.
activities.why: Your own city has more novelty than any feed.
steps: Note one thing that surprised you

activities.title: Cook dinner for someone
activities.desc: Make a simple meal for a friend, partner or family member.
activities.why: Feeding someone is one of the oldest ways to show care.

activities.title: Send a voice note to an old friend
activities.desc: Thirty seconds of your actual voice, saying you thought of them.
activities.why: Voice carries warmth that text cannot.

activities.title: Ask a family member a story question
activities.desc: Ask a parent or grandparent about a time before you were born.
activities.why: Stories connect generations — and they will not be around forever.
steps: Ask: “What was your first job like?”

activities.title: Host a no-phones chai hour
activities.desc: Invite two or three people; phones go in a basket.
activities.why: Undivided attention is rare and people notice it.

activities.title: Compliment three people today
activities.desc: Specific, honest compliments to three different people.
activities.why: Small kindness lifts both people involved.

activities.title: Learn a card trick
activities.desc: One simple trick, practised until it is smooth.
activities.why: A new skill you can show someone tonight.

activities.title: Learn the stars you can see tonight
activities.desc: Find three constellations or bright planets.
activities.why: Looking up connects you to something bigger.

activities.title: Teach yourself to tie five knots
activities.desc: Reef, bowline, clove hitch, figure-eight, sheet bend.
activities.why: Useful, tactile and satisfying to master.
steps: Get a piece of rope or cord
Learn one knot at a time

activities.title: Map your family tree
activities.desc: Draw as many generations as you can remember, then ask to fill gaps.
activities.why: Knowing where you come from is grounding.
steps: Call someone to fill one gap

activities.title: Learn to cook one regional dish
activities.desc: Pick a dish from a state or country you have never tasted.
activities.why: Learning through taste is the most fun kind.

activities.title: Five-minute body scan
activities.desc: Lie down and move your attention slowly from toes to head.
activities.why: A quick reset when your head feels noisy.
steps: Notice each part of your body

activities.title: Tea without a screen
activities.desc: Make a cup of tea and drink it doing nothing else.
activities.why: Ten quiet minutes of just one thing.

activities.title: Gratitude walk
activities.desc: Walk and name one thing you are grateful for every minute.
activities.why: Combines movement with a proven mood lift.
steps: Each minute, name one good thing
Write the best one in your Journal

activities.title: Write tomorrow on paper
activities.desc: Three things that would make tomorrow good, on paper.
activities.why: Sleep easier with tomorrow already sorted.
steps: Leave it where you will see it

activities.title: Single-task an hour
activities.desc: One task, one hour, notifications off.
activities.why: Deep focus feels better than constant switching.

activities.title: Yoga for beginners
activities.desc: Sun salutations, a few standing poses and a rest.
activities.why: Strength, flexibility and calm in one go.

activities.title: Play badminton or cricket
activities.desc: Grab a friend and a racquet or bat — the street works.
activities.why: Play is exercise you forget you are doing.

activities.title: Take the stairs challenge
activities.desc: Climb stairs for ten minutes at a steady pace.
activities.why: Quick cardio, no gear, anywhere.
steps: Climb up and down for ten minutes

activities.title: Cycle somewhere instead of riding
activities.desc: Pick a short errand and cycle there.
activities.why: Turns a chore into movement and fresh air.

activities.title: Swim a few laps
activities.desc: A local pool, a few slow laps.
activities.why: Water calms the mind and works the whole body.
steps: Float for a minute at the end

activities.title: Bake bread or rotis from scratch
activities.desc: Flour, water, your hands. Knead it properly.
activities.why: Kneading is surprisingly meditative.

activities.title: Make a fresh chutney
activities.desc: Mint, coriander, tomato or coconut — fresh and quick.
activities.why: Big flavour from a few minutes of work.
steps: Have it with your next meal

activities.title: Recreate a childhood dish
activities.desc: Cook something you loved as a kid. Call whoever made it for tips.
activities.why: Taste is a direct line to memory.
steps: Cook it and save the memory

activities.title: Plan and prep tomorrow’s lunch
activities.desc: Cook something simple tonight for tomorrow.
activities.why: Future you will be grateful.

activities.title: Make a playlist for a friend
activities.desc: Ten songs that remind you of them, in order.
activities.why: A gift that says “I know you”.
steps: Send it with one line of why

activities.title: Listen to a full album, lights off
activities.desc: One album, start to finish, doing nothing else.
activities.why: Real listening is a different experience from background noise.

activities.title: Learn the chords of one song
activities.desc: Guitar, ukulele, keyboard — three or four chords.
activities.why: Most songs need only a few chords.

activities.title: Go to a live gig or open mic
activities.desc: Any local live music, any genre.
activities.why: Live music hits differently with people around you.
steps: Stay for at least three acts

activities.title: Sing your favourite song out loud
activities.desc: Full volume, every word.
activities.why: Singing releases tension and lifts mood fast.

activities.title: Discover a new genre
activities.desc: Pick a genre you never listen to and find three songs you like.
activities.why: Stretching your taste is like travel for your ears.

activities.title: Help a neighbour with something
activities.desc: Carry groceries, water plants, or just ask if they need anything.
activities.why: Belonging starts on your own street.

activities.title: Join a local club or group
activities.desc: A running club, book club, choir, or hobby meetup.
activities.why: Regular faces turn into friends.

activities.title: Pick up litter for twenty minutes
activities.desc: A bag, gloves and your street or park.
activities.why: Visible good you can see immediately.

activities.title: Donate things you do not use
activities.desc: Clothes, books or kitchenware someone else could use.
activities.why: Lighter home, useful gift.

activities.title: Teach someone something you know
activities.desc: A skill, a recipe, a shortcut — share it with someone who wants it.
activities.why: Teaching deepens your own skill and helps someone else.

activities.title: Write a thank-you note to a local worker
activities.desc: Your doctor, a shopkeeper, a teacher, the security guard.
activities.why: People rarely hear how much they matter.

activities.title: Fix one small broken thing
activities.desc: A loose handle, a wobbly chair, a dead bulb.
activities.why: A small repair is a big feeling of competence.
steps: Find out how to fix it

activities.title: Repot or propagate plants
activities.desc: Take cuttings from a plant and put them in water.
activities.why: Free new plants and something to watch grow.
steps: Cut a stem below a node
Put it in water by a window

activities.title: Organise one drawer
activities.desc: Empty it, sort it, put back only what belongs.
activities.why: A tidy drawer is a tiny calm space.

activities.title: Print and frame a photo
activities.desc: One photo you love, off your phone and onto the wall.
activities.why: Memories you see daily beat ones buried in a gallery.
steps: Frame or tape it somewhere visible

activities.title: Deep-clean your desk
activities.desc: Wipe, sort, and reset your work surface.
activities.why: A clear desk makes starting easier.

activities.title: Solve a jigsaw puzzle
activities.desc: Even a 300-piece puzzle — alone or with someone.
activities.why: Absorbing, calm and endlessly satisfying.
steps: Work on it for an hour

activities.title: Play chess or carrom
activities.desc: With a friend or family member, on a real board.
activities.why: Strategy and laughter with someone across from you.

activities.title: Do a crossword or sudoku on paper
activities.desc: From a newspaper or a printed puzzle book.
activities.why: A finite puzzle with a satisfying finish.

activities.title: Build something with LEGO or blocks
activities.desc: No instructions — build what you imagine.
activities.why: Play is not just for kids; it restores adults too.

activities.title: Play a party game
activities.desc: Charades, Pictionary, Antakshari — with two or more people.
activities.why: Shared laughter is the fastest route to closeness.

activities.title: Fly a kite
activities.desc: Find an open roof or field and get it up in the wind.
activities.why: Joyful, outdoors and impossible while scrolling.

activities.title: Take a long, unhurried shower
activities.desc: Warm water, no rush, your favourite music.
activities.why: Simple care for your body counts.

activities.title: Go to bed an hour early
activities.desc: Phone charging outside the bedroom tonight.
activities.why: Sleep fixes more than most apps can.
steps: Charge your phone in another room

activities.title: Cook yourself a nourishing meal
activities.desc: Something warm and wholesome, made just for you.
activities.why: Caring for yourself is a skill worth practising.
steps: Eat at a table, no screens

activities.title: Do a digital declutter
activities.desc: Delete apps you do not use and turn off non-essential notifications.
activities.why: Fewer pings, more peace.
steps: Move social apps off your home screen

activities.title: Take a nap guilt-free
activities.desc: Twenty minutes, alarm set.
activities.why: Rest is productive.

activities.title: Write down what is worrying you
activities.desc: Empty your head onto paper, then circle one thing you can act on.
activities.why: Worries shrink when they are written down.
steps: Circle the one you can act on

activities.title: Take a bus to its last stop
activities.desc: Hop on a local bus and ride it to the end of the line.
activities.why: Adventure is closer than you think.

activities.title: Visit a museum or gallery
activities.desc: Spend time with three pieces rather than rushing all of them.
activities.why: Slow looking is deeply restoring.

activities.title: Eat at a place you have never tried
activities.desc: A local stall or small restaurant, ordering something new.
activities.why: New tastes make ordinary days memorable.
steps: Pick a place you always pass

activities.title: Visit a local market
activities.desc: Wander a fresh market or bazaar and talk to one vendor.
activities.why: Colour, smell and people — a full-sense experience.

activities.title: Plan a day trip
activities.desc: Pick a place within two hours and plan the route, food and stops.
activities.why: Planning is half the joy.

activities.title: Visit a temple, church or historic site
activities.desc: Somewhere old nearby you have never really looked at.
activities.why: History in your own city gives perspective.
steps: Sit there quietly for ten minutes
